translations.literal: On the gengzi day of the sixth month of the first year of Daming of Emperor Xiao of Song, a white rabbit appeared at Jimo; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi day of the sixth month of the first year of Daming under Emperor Xiao of Song, a white rabbit appeared at Jimo, was captured, and was presented.

sentences.zh: 大明六年八月辛未，白兔見北海，青、冀二州刺史劉道隆以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the eighth month of the sixth year of Daming, a white rabbit appeared in Beihai; the Inspector of Qing and Ji, Liu Daolong, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the eighth month of the sixth year of Daming, a white rabbit appeared in Beihai, and Liu Daolong, Inspector of Qing and Ji, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明六年六月乙丑，白兔見，青、冀二州刺史劉道隆以獻。

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the sixth month of the sixth year of Daming, a white rabbit appeared; the Inspector of Qing and Ji, Liu Daolong, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the sixth month of the sixth year of Daming, a white rabbit appeared, and Liu Daolong, Inspector of Qing and Ji, presented it.

sentences.zh: 斗殞精

translations.literal: Fallen Dipper Essence
translations.idiomatic: Fallen Dipper Essence

sentences.zh: 斗殞精，王者孝行溢則見。

translations.literal: Fallen Dipper Essence—when a king's filial conduct overflows, it appears.
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler's filial devotion overflows, Fallen Dipper Essence appears.

sentences.zh: 赤烏

translations.literal: Red Crow
translations.idiomatic: Red Crow

sentences.zh: 赤烏，周武王時銜穀至，兵不血刃而殷服。

translations.literal: The red crow—in the time of King Wu of Zhou, it came bearing grain in its beak; weapons were not bloodied and Yin submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of King Wu of Zhou, the red crow came bearing grain in its beak; arms were not stained with blood and Yin submitted.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和中，赤烏見郡國。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe era of Emperor Zhang of Han, red crows appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era under Emperor Zhang of Han, red crows appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 吳孫權赤烏元年，有赤烏集於殿前。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chiwu of Sun Quan of Wu, red crows gathered before the palace hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chiwu under Sun Quan of Wu, red crows gathered before the palace hall.

sentences.zh: 吳孫休永安三年三月，西陵言赤烏見。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Yong'an of Sun Xiu of Wu, Xiling reported a red crow appearing.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Yong'an under Sun Xiu of Wu, Xiling reported a red crow.

sentences.zh: 晉元帝永昌二年正月，赤烏見暨陽。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Yongchang of Emperor Yuan of Jin, a red crow appeared in Jiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Yongchang under Emperor Yuan of Jin, a red crow appeared in Jiyang.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝永初二年二月，赤烏六見北海都昌。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year of Yongchu of Emperor Wu of Song, six red crows appeared at Duchang in Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year of Yongchu under Emperor Wu of Song, six red crows appeared at Duchang in Beihai.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明五年六月戊子，赤烏見蜀郡，益州刺史劉思考以獻。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the sixth month of the fifth year of Daming of Emperor Xiao of Song, a red crow appeared in Shu Commandery; the Inspector of Yizhou Liu Sikao presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the sixth month of the fifth year of Daming under Emperor Xiao of Song, a red crow appeared in Shu Commandery, and Liu Sikao, Inspector of Yizhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 白燕者，師曠時，銜丹書來至。

translations.literal: As for white swallows, in the time of Music Master Kuang one came bearing a red scroll.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Music Master Kuang, a white swallow came bearing a red scroll.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和中，白燕見郡國。

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe era of Emperor Zhang of Han, white swallows appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era under Emperor Zhang of Han, white swallows appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 晉惠帝元康元年七月，白燕二見酒泉祿福，太守索靖以聞。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the first year of Yuankang of Emperor Hui of Jin, two white swallows appeared at Lufu in Jiuquan; the grand administrator Suo Jing reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of Yuankang under Emperor Hui of Jin, two white swallows appeared at Lufu in Jiuquan, and Suo Jing, grand administrator of Jiuquan, reported it.

sentences.zh: 宋文帝元嘉元年七月壬戌，白燕集齊郡城，游翔庭宇，經九日乃去，眾燕隨從無數。

translations.literal: On the renxu day of the seventh month of the first year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen of Song, white swallows gathered at the city of Qi Commandery, flying about the courtyard halls; after nine days they departed, and countless ordinary swallows followed.
translations.idiomatic: On the renxu day of the seventh month of the first year of Yuanjia under Emperor Wen of Song, white swallows gathered at the city of Qi Commandery and flew about the courtyard halls; after nine days they left, followed by countless ordinary swallows.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十四年，白燕集荊州府門，刺史臨川王義慶以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, white swallows gathered at the gate of the Jingzhou headquarters; the Inspector, the Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, white swallows gathered at the gate of the Jingzhou headquarters, and Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan and Inspector of Jingzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十八年六月，白燕產丹徒縣，南徐州刺史南譙王義宣以聞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year of Yuanjia, white swallows nested in Dantu County; the Inspector of South Xuzhou, the Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year of Yuanjia, white swallows nested in Dantu County, and Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao and Inspector of South Xuzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十年五月，白燕集南平郡府內，內史臧綽以聞。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, white swallows gathered within the headquarters of Nanping Commandery; the Administrator Zang Chuo reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, white swallows gathered within the headquarters of Nanping Commandery, and Zang Chuo, administrator of Nanping, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十一年，白燕見廣陵，南兗州刺史廣陵王誕以獻。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year of Yuanjia, white swallows appeared in Guangling; the Inspector of South Yanzhou, the Prince of Guangling Dan, presented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Yuanjia, white swallows appeared in Guangling, and Dan, Prince of Guangling and Inspector of South Yanzhou, presented them.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十四年五月辛未，白燕集司徒府西園，太尉江夏王義恭以聞。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the fifth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, white swallows gathered in the western garden of the Minister of Works office; the Grand Commandant, the Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fifth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, white swallows gathered in the western garden of the Minister of Works office, and Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Grand Commandant, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年八月壬子，白燕見廣陵城，南兗州刺史徐湛之以聞。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, white swallows appeared at the city of Guangling; the Inspector of South Yanzhou Xu Zhanzhi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi day of the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, white swallows appeared at the city of Guangling, and Xu Zhanzhi, Inspector of South Yanzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十六年五月戊寅，白燕產衡陽王墓亭，郎中令朱曠之獲以聞。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day of the fifth month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, white swallows nested at the pavilion of the tomb of the Prince of Hengyang; the Director of Palace Attendants Zhu Kuangzhi captured them and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuyin day of the fifth month of the twenty-sixth year of Yuanjia, white swallows nested at the pavilion of the tomb of the Prince of Hengyang, and Zhu Kuangzhi, Director of Palace Attendants, captured them and reported it.

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, white swallows nested at Jingkou; the Inspector of South Xuzhou, the Prince of Shixing Jun, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the fifth month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, white swallows nested at Jingkou, and Jun, Prince of Shixing and Inspector of South Xuzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十七年六月壬辰，白燕見秣陵，丹陽尹徐湛之以獻。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, white swallows appeared in Moling; the Director of Danyang Xu Zhanzhi presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen day of the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, white swallows appeared in Moling, and Xu Zhanzhi, Director of Danyang, presented them.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明二年五月乙巳，白燕產南郡江陵民家，荊州刺史朱脩之以獻。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the fifth month of the second year of Daming of Emperor Xiao of Song, white swallows nested at a commoner's home in Jiangling, Nan Commandery; the Inspector of Jingzhou Zhu Xiuzhi presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the fifth month of the second year of Daming under Emperor Xiao of Song, white swallows nested at a commoner's home in Jiangling, Nan Commandery, and Zhu Xiuzhi, Inspector of Jingzhou, presented them.

sentences.zh: 大明二年五月甲子，白燕二產山陽縣舍，南兗州刺史竟陵王誕以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the fifth month of the second year of Daming, two white swallows nested at a lodge in Shanyang County; the Inspector of South Yanzhou, the Prince of Jingling Dan, presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fifth month of the second year of Daming, two white swallows nested at a lodge in Shanyang County, and Dan, Prince of Jingling and Inspector of South Yanzhou, presented them.

sentences.zh: 大明二年六月甲戌，白燕產吳郡城內，太守王翼之以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the sixth month of the second year of Daming, white swallows nested within the city of Wu Commandery; the grand administrator Wang Yizhi presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the sixth month of the second year of Daming, white swallows nested within the city of Wu Commandery, and Wang Yizhi, grand administrator of Wu Commandery, presented them.

sentences.zh: 大明三年五月甲申，白燕產武陵臨沅民家，郢州刺史孔靈符以聞。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the fifth month of the third year of Daming, white swallows nested at a commoner's home in Linyuan, Wuling; the Inspector of Yingzhou Kong Lingfu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the fifth month of the third year of Daming, white swallows nested at a commoner's home in Linyuan, Wuling, and Kong Lingfu, Inspector of Yingzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明四年六月乙卯，白燕見平昌，青州刺史劉道隆以獻。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the sixth month of the fourth year of Daming, white swallows appeared in Pingchang; the Inspector of Qingzhou Liu Daolong presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the sixth month of the fourth year of Daming, white swallows appeared in Pingchang, and Liu Daolong, Inspector of Qingzhou, presented them.

translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Taishi under Emperor Ming of Song, white swallows appeared in Lingling, were captured, and were presented.

translations.literal: In the Yuanhe era of Emperor Zhang of Han, three-legged crows appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuanhe era under Emperor Zhang of Han, three-legged crows appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 象車

translations.literal: Elephant Chariot
translations.idiomatic: Elephant Chariot

sentences.zh: 象車者，山之精也。

translations.literal: The elephant chariot is the essence of mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The elephant chariot is the essence of the mountains.

sentences.zh: 王者德澤流洽四境則出。

translations.literal: When a king's virtue and grace flow and reach the four borders, it appears.
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler's virtue and grace flow to the four borders, it appears.

translations.literal: (lacuna)
translations.idiomatic: (text missing in source)

sentences.zh: 白烏

translations.literal: White Crow
translations.idiomatic: White Crow

sentences.zh: 白烏，王者宗廟肅敬則至。

translations.literal: The white crow—when a king is solemn and reverent in the ancestral temple, it arrives.
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler is solemn and reverent in the ancestral temple, the white crow arrives.

sentences.zh: 漢桓帝永壽元年四月，白烏見齊國。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Yongshou of Emperor Huan of Han, a white crow appeared in Qi State.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Yongshou under Emperor Huan of Han, a white crow appeared in Qi State.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝咸寧五年七月戊辰，白烏見濟南隰陰，太守獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the seventh month of the fifth year of Xianning of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white crow appeared at Xiyin in Jinan; the grand administrator captured it and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the seventh month of the fifth year of Xianning under Emperor Wu of Jin, a white crow appeared at Xiyin in Jinan, and the grand administrator captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康元年五月庚午，白烏見襄城。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the fifth month of the first year of Taikang of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white crow appeared in Xiangcheng.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the fifth month of the first year of Taikang under Emperor Wu of Jin, a white crow appeared in Xiangcheng.

sentences.zh: 太康十年五月丁丑，白烏見京兆長安。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the fifth month of the tenth year of Taikang, a white crow appeared in Chang'an, Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the fifth month of the tenth year of Taikang, a white crow appeared in Chang'an, Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 晉惠帝元康元年四月，白烏見河南成臯，縣令劉機獲以聞。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Yuankang of Emperor Hui of Jin, a white crow appeared at Chenggao in Henan; the magistrate Liu Ji captured it and reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Yuankang under Emperor Hui of Jin, a white crow appeared at Chenggao in Henan, and Liu Ji, magistrate of Chenggao, captured and reported it.

sentences.zh: 元康元年五月戊戌，白烏見梁國睢陽。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the fifth month of the first year of Yuankang, a white crow appeared in Suiyang, Liang State.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu day of the fifth month of the first year of Yuankang, a white crow appeared in Suiyang, Liang State.

sentences.zh: 元康元年七月辛丑，白烏見陳留，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the seventh month of the first year of Yuankang, a white crow appeared in Chenliu; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the seventh month of the first year of Yuankang, a white crow appeared in Chenliu, was captured, and was presented.

sentences.zh: 元康四年十月，白烏見鄱陽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Yuankang, a white crow appeared in Poyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fourth year of Yuankang, a white crow appeared in Poyang.

sentences.zh: 晉明帝太寧二年十一月，白烏見京都。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year of Taining of Emperor Ming of Jin, a white crow appeared in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year of Taining under Emperor Ming of Jin, a white crow appeared in the capital.

sentences.zh: 太寧三年三月，白烏見吳郡海虞，獲以獻，羣官畢賀。

translations.literal: In the third month of the third year of Taining, a white crow appeared at Haiyu in Wu Commandery; it was captured and presented, and all officials congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of Taining, a white crow appeared at Haiyu in Wu Commandery, was captured and presented, and all officials offered congratulations.

sentences.zh: 晉孝武帝太元十一年八月乙酉，白烏集江州寺庭，羣烏翔衞。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the eighth month of the eleventh year of Taiyuan of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, a white crow gathered in the temple courtyard of Jiang Province; a flock of crows flew as escort.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the eighth month of the eleventh year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, a white crow gathered in the temple courtyard of Jiang Province while a flock of crows flew as escort.

sentences.zh: 太元二十一年五月癸卯，白烏見吳國，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the guimao day of the fifth month of the twenty-first year of Taiyuan, a white crow appeared in Wu State; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao day of the fifth month of the twenty-first year of Taiyuan, a white crow appeared in Wu State, was captured, and was presented.

sentences.zh: 宋武帝永初二年六月丁酉，白烏見吳郡婁縣，太守孟顗以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingyou day of the sixth month of the second year of Yongchu of Emperor Wu of Song, a white crow appeared at Lou County in Wu Commandery; the grand administrator Meng Yan presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingyou day of the sixth month of the second year of Yongchu under Emperor Wu of Song, a white crow appeared at Lou County in Wu Commandery, and Meng Yan, grand administrator of Wu Commandery, presented it.

sentences.zh: 文帝元嘉二年十一月丙辰，白烏見山陽，太守阮寶以聞。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the eleventh month of the second year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen of Song, a white crow appeared in Shanyang; the grand administrator Ruan Bao reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingchen day of the eleventh month of the second year of Yuanjia under Emperor Wen of Song, a white crow appeared in Shanyang, and Ruan Bao, grand administrator of Shanyang, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉三年三月甲戌，丹陽湖熟薛爽之獲白烏以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the third month of the third year of Yuanjia, Xue Shuangzhi of Hushu in Danyang captured a white crow and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiaxu day of the third month of the third year of Yuanjia, Xue Shuangzhi of Hushu in Danyang captured a white crow and presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十一年六月乙巳，吳郡海鹽王說獲白烏，揚州刺史彭城王義康以獻。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the sixth month of the eleventh year of Yuanjia, Wang Yue of Haiyan in Wu Commandery captured a white crow; the Inspector of Yangzhou, the Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the sixth month of the eleventh year of Yuanjia, Wang Yue of Haiyan in Wu Commandery captured a white crow, and Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng and Inspector of Yangzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十三年三月戊辰，義興陽羨令獲白烏，太守劉禎以獻。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the third month of the thirteenth year of Yuanjia, the magistrate of Yangxian in Yixing captured a white crow; the grand administrator Liu Zhen presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuchen day of the third month of the thirteenth year of Yuanjia, the magistrate of Yangxian in Yixing captured a white crow, and Liu Zhen, grand administrator of Yixing, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十九年五月，海陵王文秀獲白烏，南兗州刺史臨川王義慶以獻。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year of Yuanjia, Wang Wenxiu of Hailing captured a white crow; the Inspector of South Yanzhou, the Prince of Linchuan Yiqing, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year of Yuanjia, Wang Wenxiu of Hailing captured a white crow, and Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan and Inspector of South Yanzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十九年十月，白烏產晉陵暨陽僑民彭城劉原秀宅樹，原秀以聞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year of Yuanjia, a white crow nested in a tree at the home of Liu Yuanxiu of Pengcheng, a resident of Jiyang in Jinling; Yuanxiu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the nineteenth year of Yuanjia, a white crow nested in a tree at the home of Liu Yuanxiu of Pengcheng, a resident of Jiyang in Jinling, and Yuanxiu reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十年七月，彭城劉原秀又獲白烏以獻。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, Liu Yuanxiu of Pengcheng again captured a white crow and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, Liu Yuanxiu of Pengcheng again captured a white crow and presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十四年八月乙巳，白烏見晉陵，南徐州刺史廣陵王誕以獻。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, a white crow appeared in Jinling; the Inspector of South Xuzhou, the Prince of Guangling Dan, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yisi day of the eighth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, a white crow appeared in Jinling, and Dan, Prince of Guangling and Inspector of South Xuzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明元年四月甲申，白烏見南郡江陵。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the fourth month of the first year of Daming of Emperor Xiao of Song, a white crow appeared at Jiangling in Nan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen day of the fourth month of the first year of Daming under Emperor Xiao of Song, a white crow appeared at Jiangling in Nan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 明帝泰始二年六月丁巳，白烏見吳郡海鹽，太守顧覬之以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the sixth month of the second year of Taishi of Emperor Ming of Song, a white crow appeared at Haiyan in Wu Commandery; the grand administrator Gu Kuizhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingsi day of the sixth month of the second year of Taishi under Emperor Ming of Song, a white crow appeared at Haiyan in Wu Commandery, and Gu Kuizhi, grand administrator of Wu Commandery, presented it.

sentences.zh: 泰始二年九月壬寅，白烏見吳興烏程，太守郄顒以獻。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the ninth month of the second year of Taishi, a white crow appeared at Wucheng in Wuxing; the grand administrator Qie Yong presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the ninth month of the second year of Taishi, a white crow appeared at Wucheng in Wuxing, and Qie Yong, grand administrator of Wuxing, presented it.

sentences.zh: 白雀

translations.literal: White Sparrow
translations.idiomatic: White Sparrow

sentences.zh: 白雀者，王者爵祿均則至。

translations.literal: The white sparrow—when a king's ranks and stipends are equitable, it arrives.
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler's ranks and stipends are fair and equitable, the white sparrow arrives.

sentences.zh: 漢章帝元和初，白雀見郡國。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuanhe era of Emperor Zhang of Han, white sparrows appeared in the commanderies and kingdoms.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanhe era under Emperor Zhang of Han, white sparrows appeared throughout the commanderies and kingdoms.

sentences.zh: 魏文帝初，郡國十九言白雀見。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Wen of Wei, nineteen commanderies and kingdoms reported that white sparrows had appeared.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the reign of Emperor Wen of Wei, nineteen commanderies and kingdoms reported the appearance of white sparrows.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝咸寧元年，白雀見梁國，梁王肜獲以獻。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xianning of Emperor Wu of Jin, a white sparrow appeared in Liang State; the Prince of Liang Rong captured it and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xianning under Emperor Wu of Jin, a white sparrow appeared in Liang State, and Rong, Prince of Liang, captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉武帝太康二年六月丁卯，白雀二見河內南陽，太守阮侃獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day of the sixth month of the second year of Taikang of Emperor Wu of Jin, two white sparrows appeared at Nanyang in Henei; the grand administrator Ruan Kan captured them and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the sixth month of the second year of Taikang under Emperor Wu of Jin, two white sparrows appeared at Nanyang in Henei, and Ruan Kan, grand administrator of Henei, captured and presented them.

sentences.zh: 太康二年六月，白雀二見河南，河南尹向雄獲以獻。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the second year of Taikang, two white sparrows appeared in Henan; the Governor of Henan Xiang Xiong captured them and presented them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of Taikang, two white sparrows appeared in Henan, and Xiang Xiong, Governor of Henan, captured and presented them.

sentences.zh: 太康七年七月庚午，白雀見豫章。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the seventh month of the seventh year of Taikang, a white sparrow appeared in Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengwu day of the seventh month of the seventh year of Taikang, a white sparrow appeared in Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 太康八年八月，白雀見河南洛陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year of Taikang, a white sparrow appeared in Luoyang, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the eighth year of Taikang, a white sparrow appeared in Luoyang, Henan.

sentences.zh: 太康十年五月丁亥，白雀見宣光北門，華林園令孫邵獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the fifth month of the tenth year of Taikang, a white sparrow appeared at the Xinguang North Gate; the Director of the Hualin Park Sun Shao captured it and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the fifth month of the tenth year of Taikang, a white sparrow appeared at the Xinguang North Gate, and Sun Shao, Director of the Hualin Park, captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 晉愍帝建武元年四月，尚書僕射刁協獻白雀於晉王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Jianwu of Emperor Min of Jin, the Vice Director of the Masters of Writing Diao Xie presented a white sparrow to the Prince of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Jianwu under Emperor Min of Jin, Diao Xie, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, presented a white sparrow to the Prince of Jin.

sentences.zh: 晉孝武帝太元十六年十二月，白雀見南海增城縣民吳比屋。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the sixteenth year of Taiyuan of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, a white sparrow appeared at the home of Wu Bi, a commoner of Zengcheng County in Nanhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the sixteenth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, a white sparrow appeared at the home of Wu Bi, a commoner of Zengcheng County in Nanhai.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝隆安五年十一月，白雀見宜都。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Longan of Emperor An of Jin, a white sparrow appeared in Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Longan under Emperor An of Jin, a white sparrow appeared in Yidu.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝元興三年六月丙申，白雀見豫章新淦，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the bingshen day of the sixth month of the third year of Yuanxing of Emperor An of Jin, a white sparrow appeared at Xingan in Yuzhang; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingshen day of the sixth month of the third year of Yuanxing under Emperor An of Jin, a white sparrow appeared at Xingan in Yuzhang and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 宋文帝元嘉元年七月己巳，白雀見齊郡昌國。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the seventh month of the first year of Yuanjia of Emperor Wen of Song, a white sparrow appeared in Changguo, Qi Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the seventh month of the first year of Yuanjia under Emperor Wen of Song, a white sparrow appeared in Changguo in Qi Commandery.

sentences.zh: 元嘉四年七月乙酉，白雀見北海劇。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the seventh month of the fourth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared at Ju in Beihai.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiyou day of the seventh month of the fourth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared at Ju in Beihai.

sentences.zh: 元嘉八年五月辛丑，白雀集左衞府。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the fifth month of the eighth year of Yuanjia, white sparrows gathered at the Left Guard headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the fifth month of the eighth year of Yuanjia, white sparrows gathered at the headquarters of the Left Guard.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十一年五月丁丑，齊郡西安宗顯獲白雀，青州刺史段宏以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the fifth month of the eleventh year of Yuanjia, Zong Xian of Xi'an in Qi Commandery captured a white sparrow; the Inspector of Qingzhou Duan Hong presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the fifth month of the eleventh year of Yuanjia, Zong Xian of Xi'an in Qi Commandery captured a white sparrow, and Duan Hong, Inspector of Qingzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十四年五月甲午，白雀集費縣員外散騎侍郎顏敬家，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day of the fifth month of the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow gathered at the home of Yan Jing, Supernumerary Attendant Gentleman of the Cavaliers in Attendance, in Fei County; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu day of the fifth month of the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow gathered at the home of Yan Jing, Supernumerary Attendant Gentleman of the Cavaliers in Attendance, in Fei County, and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十四年，白雀二見荊州府客館。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, two white sparrows appeared at the guest lodge of the Jingzhou headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Yuanjia, two white sparrows appeared at the guest lodge of the Jingzhou headquarters.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十五年五月辛未，白雀集建康都亭里，揚州刺史彭城王義康以聞。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the fifth month of the fifteenth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow gathered in Duting Ward in Jiankang; the Inspector of Yangzhou, the Prince of Pengcheng Yikang, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fifth month of the fifteenth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow gathered in Duting Ward in Jiankang, and Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng and Inspector of Yangzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十五年六月，白雀見建康定陰里，彭城王義康以獻。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the fifteenth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Dingyin Ward in Jiankang; the Prince of Pengcheng Yikang presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the fifteenth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Dingyin Ward in Jiankang, and Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十五年八月，白雀見西陽，江州刺史南譙王義宣以獻。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the fifteenth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Xiyang; the Inspector of Jiangzhou, the Prince of Nanqiao Yixuan, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifteenth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Xiyang, and Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao and Inspector of Jiangzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十七年五月壬寅，白雀二集荊州後園，刺史衡陽王義季以聞。

translations.literal: On the renyin day of the fifth month of the seventeenth year of Yuanjia, two white sparrows gathered in the rear garden of the Jingzhou headquarters; the Inspector, the Prince of Hengyang Yiji, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin day of the fifth month of the seventeenth year of Yuanjia, two white sparrows gathered in the rear garden of the Jingzhou headquarters, and Yiji, Prince of Hengyang and Inspector of Jingzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉十八年七月，吳郡鹽官于玄獲白雀，太守劉禎以獻。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eighteenth year of Yuanjia, Yu Xuan, salt administrator of Wu Commandery, captured a white sparrow; the grand administrator Liu Zhen presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the eighteenth year of Yuanjia, Yu Xuan, salt administrator of Wu Commandery, captured a white sparrow, and Liu Zhen, grand administrator of Wu Commandery, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十年五月乙卯，秣陵衞猗之獲白雀，丹陽尹徐湛之以獻。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the fifth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, Yi Zhizhi of Moling Guard captured a white sparrow; the Prefect of Danyang Xu Zhanzhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the fifth month of the twentieth year of Yuanjia, Yi Zhizhi of Moling Guard captured a white sparrow, and Xu Zhanzhi, Prefect of Danyang, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十二年四月丙子，白雀見東安郡，徐州刺史臧質以獻。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the fourth month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Dong'an Commandery; the Inspector of Xuzhou Zang Zhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the fourth month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Dong'an Commandery, and Zang Zhi, Inspector of Xuzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十二年閏五月丙午，白雀見華林園，員外散騎侍郎長沙王瑾獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in the Hualin Park; Wang Jin of Changsha, Supernumerary Attendant Gentleman of the Cavaliers in Attendance, captured it and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the intercalary fifth month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in the Hualin Park, and Wang Jin of Changsha, Supernumerary Attendant Gentleman of the Cavaliers in Attendance, captured and presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十二年六月庚申，南彭城蕃縣時佛護獲白雀以獻。

translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the sixth month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, Shi Fohu of Fan County in South Pengcheng captured a white sparrow and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the sixth month of the twenty-second year of Yuanjia, Shi Fohu of Fan County in South Pengcheng captured a white sparrow and presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十四年四月，白雀產吳郡鹽官民家，太守劉禎以獻。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow nested in the home of a commoner in the salt office of Wu Commandery; the grand administrator Liu Zhen presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow nested in the home of a commoner in the salt office of Wu Commandery, and Liu Zhen, grand administrator of Wu Commandery, presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十四年六月己亥，白雀五集長沙廟，長沙王瑾以聞。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, five white sparrows gathered at the Changsha shrine; Wang Jin of Changsha reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the jihai day of the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year of Yuanjia, five white sparrows gathered at the Changsha shrine, and Wang Jin of Changsha reported it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十五年五月丁丑，白雀二見京都，材官吏黃公歡、軍人丁田夫各獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, two white sparrows appeared in the capital; Huang Gonghuan, clerk of the Directorate of Works, and Ding Tianfu, a soldier, each captured one and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingchou day of the fifth month of the twenty-fifth year of Yuanjia, two white sparrows appeared in the capital; Huang Gonghuan, clerk of the Directorate of Works, and Ding Tianfu, a soldier, each captured one and presented it.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十七年六月乙卯，白雀見濟南郡，薛榮以獻。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Jinan Commandery; Xue Rong presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yimao day of the sixth month of the twenty-seventh year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Jinan Commandery, and Xue Rong presented it.

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the eighth month of the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia, a soldier of the Chongyi Guard captured a pair of white sparrows; Wang Xi, Left Leader of the Crown Prince's Household, presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the eighth month of the twenty-eighth year of Yuanjia, a soldier of the Chongyi Guard captured a pair of white sparrows, and Wang Xi, Left Leader of the Crown Prince's Household, presented them.

sentences.zh: 元嘉二十九年四月癸丑，白雀見會稽山陰，太守東海王褘獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Shanyin, Kuaiji; the grand administrator, the Prince of Donghai Hui, captured it and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the guichou day of the fourth month of the twenty-ninth year of Yuanjia, a white sparrow appeared in Shanyin in Kuaiji, and Hui, Prince of Donghai and grand administrator of Kuaiji, captured and presented it.

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the fifth month of the first year of Xiaojian of Emperor Xiao of Song, Lu Shangqi of Linyi County obtained a white sparrow on the city wall; the Grand Tutor holding the yellow axe, the Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, presented it.

sentences.zh: 孝建二年六月丙子，左衞軍獲白雀以獻。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the sixth month of the second year of Xiaojian, the Left Guard army captured a white sparrow and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the sixth month of the second year of Xiaojian, the Left Guard army captured a white sparrow and presented it.

sentences.zh: 孝建三年閏三月辛酉，黃門侍郎庾徽之家獲白雀以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the intercalary third month of the third year of Xiaojian, a white sparrow was captured at the home of Yu Hui, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gates, and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinyou day of the intercalary third month of the third year of Xiaojian, a white sparrow was captured at the home of Yu Hui, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gates, and presented to the throne.

sentences.zh: 孝建三年五月丁卯，白雀見建康，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day of the fifth month of the third year of Xiaojian, a white sparrow appeared in Jiankang; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the fifth month of the third year of Xiaojian, a white sparrow appeared in Jiankang and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明元年四月戊申，白雀見尋陽。

translations.literal: On the wushen day of the fourth month of the first year of Daming of Emperor Xiao of Song, a white sparrow appeared in Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: On the wushen day of the fourth month of the first year of Daming under Emperor Xiao of Song, a white sparrow appeared in Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 大明元年五月甲寅，白雀二見渤海，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the fifth month of the first year of Daming, two white sparrows appeared in Bohai; they were captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin day of the fifth month of the first year of Daming, two white sparrows appeared in Bohai and were captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 大明元年五月甲子，白雀見建康，獲以獻。

translations.literal: On the jiazi day of the fifth month of the first year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Jiankang; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiazi day of the fifth month of the first year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Jiankang and was captured and presented.

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the sixth month of the first year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Qiyang, Lingling; it was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the sixth month of the first year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Qiyang in Lingling and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 大明元年七月辛亥，白雀見南陽宛，獲以獻。

translations.idiomatic: On the xinhai day of the seventh month of the first year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Wan in Nanyang and was captured and presented.

sentences.zh: 大明二年五月丁未，白雀見建康，揚州刺史西陽王子尚以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day of the fifth month of the second year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Jiankang; the Inspector of Yangzhou, the Prince of Xiyang Zishang, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingwei day of the fifth month of the second year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Jiankang, and Zishang, Prince of Xiyang and Inspector of Yangzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明二年六月丁亥，白雀見河東定襄縣，荊州刺史朱脩之以聞。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day of the sixth month of the second year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Dingxiang County, Hedong; the Inspector of Jingzhou Zhu Xiuzhi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dinghai day of the sixth month of the second year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Dingxiang County in Hedong, and Zhu Xiuzhi, Inspector of Jingzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 大明三年四月庚戌，白雀見秣陵，丹陽尹劉秀之以獻。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the fourth month of the third year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Moling; the Prefect of Danyang Liu Xiuzhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the fourth month of the third year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Moling, and Liu Xiuzhi, Prefect of Danyang, presented it.

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the fifth month of the third year of Daming, a soldier of the Chongyi unit in the Grand Mentor's office captured a white sparrow; the Grand Mentor, the Prince of Jiangxia Yigong, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the fifth month of the third year of Daming, a soldier of the Chongyi unit in the Grand Mentor's office captured a white sparrow, and Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Grand Mentor, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明四年五月辛巳，白雀見廣陵，侍中顏師伯以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the fifth month of the fourth year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Guangling; the Palace Attendant Yan Shibo presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the fifth month of the fourth year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Guangling, and Yan Shibo, Palace Attendant, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明五年四月庚戌，白雀見晉陵，太守沈文叔以獻。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the fourth month of the fifth year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Jinling; the grand administrator Shen Wenshu presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu day of the fourth month of the fifth year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Jinling, and Shen Wenshu, grand administrator of Jinling, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明五年五月癸未，白雀二見尋陽，江州刺史桂陽王休範以獻。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the fifth month of the fifth year of Daming, two white sparrows appeared in Xunyang; the Inspector of Jiangzhou, the Prince of Guiyang Xiufan, presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the fifth month of the fifth year of Daming, two white sparrows appeared in Xunyang, and Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang and Inspector of Jiangzhou, presented them.

sentences.zh: 大明五年五月癸未，白雀二見濟南，青州刺史劉道隆以獻。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the fifth month of the fifth year of Daming, two white sparrows appeared in Jinan; the Inspector of Qingzhou Liu Daolong presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei day of the fifth month of the fifth year of Daming, two white sparrows appeared in Jinan, and Liu Daolong, Inspector of Qingzhou, presented them.

sentences.zh: 大明五年十月，白雀見太原，青州刺史劉道隆以獻。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Taiyuan; the Inspector of Qingzhou Liu Daolong presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the fifth year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Taiyuan, and Liu Daolong, Inspector of Qingzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明六年八月辛巳，白雀見齊郡，青、冀二州刺史劉道隆以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinsi day of the eighth month of the sixth year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Qi Commandery; Liu Daolong, Inspector of Qing and Ji, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinsi day of the eighth month of the sixth year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Qi Commandery, and Liu Daolong, Inspector of Qing and Ji, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年四月乙未，白雀集廬陵王第，廬陵王敬先以獻。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day of the fourth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow gathered at the residence of the Prince of Luling; the Prince of Luling Jingxian presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yiwei day of the fourth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow gathered at the residence of the Prince of Luling, and Jingxian, Prince of Luling, presented it.

translations.literal: On the yichou day of the fourth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Liyang; the grand administrator, the Prince of Jianping Jingsu, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yichou day of the fourth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Liyang, and Jingsu, Prince of Jianping and grand administrator, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年五月辛未，白雀見汝陰，豫州刺史垣護之以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinwei day of the fifth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Ruyin; the Inspector of Yuzhou Yuan Huzhi presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinwei day of the fifth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Ruyin, and Yuan Huzhi, Inspector of Yuzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年六月，白雀見寶城，南豫州刺史尋陽王子房以獻。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Baocheng; the Inspector of South Yuzhou, the Prince of Xunyang Zifang, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Baocheng, and Zifang, Prince of Xunyang and Inspector of South Yuzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年十月丁卯，白雀見建康，丹陽尹永嘉王子仁以獻。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day of the tenth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Jiankang; the Prefect of Danyang, the Prince of Yongjia Ziren, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the dingmao day of the tenth month of the seventh year of Daming, a white sparrow appeared in Jiankang, and Ziren, Prince of Yongjia and Prefect of Danyang, presented it.

sentences.zh: 大明七年十一月，車駕南巡，肄水師於梁山，中江，白雀二集華蓋。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventh year of Daming, the imperial carriage toured south, drilled the navy at Liangshan mid-river, and two white sparrows gathered on the imperial canopy.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the seventh year of Daming, the emperor toured south and drilled the fleet at Liangshan on the river; two white sparrows gathered on the imperial canopy.

sentences.zh: 前廢帝永光元年四月乙亥，白雀見會稽，東揚州刺史尋陽王子房以獻。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the fourth month of the first year of Yongguang of the Former Deposed Emperor, a white sparrow appeared in Kuaiji; the Inspector of East Yangzhou, the Prince of Xunyang Zifang, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the yihai day of the fourth month of the first year of Yongguang under the Former Deposed Emperor, a white sparrow appeared in Kuaiji, and Zifang, Prince of Xunyang and Inspector of East Yangzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 永光元年六月丙子，白雀見彭城，徐州刺史義陽王昶以聞。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the sixth month of the first year of Yongguang, a white sparrow appeared in Pengcheng; the Inspector of Xuzhou, the Prince of Yiyang Chang, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingzi day of the sixth month of the first year of Yongguang, a white sparrow appeared in Pengcheng, and Chang, Prince of Yiyang and Inspector of Xuzhou, reported it.

sentences.zh: 明帝泰始二年七月戊子，白雀見虎檻洲，都督征討諸軍建安王休仁以聞。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the seventh month of the second year of Taishi of Emperor Ming of Song, a white sparrow appeared at Hujian Islet; the Commander-in-Chief of the Campaign Forces, the Prince of Jian'an Xiuren, reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuzi day of the seventh month of the second year of Taishi under Emperor Ming of Song, a white sparrow appeared at Hujian Islet, and Xiuren, Prince of Jian'an and Commander-in-Chief of the Campaign Forces, reported it.

sentences.zh: 泰始六年七月壬午，白雀二見廬陵吉陽，內史江孜以聞。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the seventh month of the sixth year of Taishi, two white sparrows appeared in Jiyang, Luling; the interior minister Jiang Zi reported it.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu day of the seventh month of the sixth year of Taishi, two white sparrows appeared in Jiyang in Luling, and Jiang Zi, interior minister of Luling, reported it.

sentences.zh: 明帝泰豫元年六月辛丑，白雀見廣州，刺史孫超以獻。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the sixth month of the first year of Taixu of Emperor Ming of Song, a white sparrow appeared in Guangzhou; the Inspector Sun Chao presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the xinchou day of the sixth month of the first year of Taixu under Emperor Ming of Song, a white sparrow appeared in Guangzhou, and Sun Chao, Inspector of Guangzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 後廢帝元徽五年四月己巳，白雀二見尋陽柴桑，江州刺史邵陵王友以獻。

translations.literal: On the jisi day of the fourth month of the fifth year of Yuanhui of the Deposed Emperor of Later Song, two white sparrows appeared at Chaisang in Xunyang; the Inspector of Jiangzhou, the Prince of Shaoling You, presented them.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi day of the fourth month of the fifth year of Yuanhui under the Deposed Emperor of Later Song, two white sparrows appeared at Chaisang in Xunyang, and You, Prince of Shaoling and Inspector of Jiangzhou, presented them.

sentences.zh: 孝武帝大明六年三月丙午，青雀見華林園。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the third month of the sixth year of Daming of Emperor Xiao of Song, an azure sparrow appeared in the Hualin Park.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingwu day of the third month of the sixth year of Daming under Emperor Xiao of Song, an azure sparrow appeared in the Hualin Park.

sentences.zh: 明帝泰始二年九月庚寅，青雀見京城內，南徐州刺史桂陽王休範以獻。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day of the ninth month of the second year of Taishi of Emperor Ming of Song, an azure sparrow appeared within the capital; the Inspector of South Xuzhou, the Prince of Guiyang Xiufan, presented it.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengyin day of the ninth month of the second year of Taishi under Emperor Ming of Song, an azure sparrow appeared within the capital, and Xiufan, Prince of Guiyang and Inspector of South Xuzhou, presented it.

sentences.zh: 玉馬

translations.literal: Jade Horse
translations.idiomatic: Jade Horse

sentences.zh: 玉馬，王者精明，尊賢者則出。

translations.literal: The jade horse—when a king is clear-sighted and discerning and honors the worthy, it appears.
translations.idiomatic: When a ruler is clear-sighted and discerning and honors the worthy, the jade horse appears.

translations.idiomatic: Root Chariot

translations.literal: The root chariot—when virtue extends to mountains and mounds, it appears.
translations.idiomatic: When virtue extends to mountains and burial mounds, the root chariot appears.
